title: WorkflowPackRegistry
description: Registry of available workflow packs defining roles, phase registrations, and directory layouts.

schema.description: Schema version identifier for workflow pack registry.

default.description: Default pack ID to use when none is explicitly requested.

packs.description: Mapping of pack IDs to workflow pack definitions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the workflow pack.

roles.description: List of role identifiers supported by this pack.

command_prefixes.description: List of command prefixes corresponding to the roles (e.g. BACK, FRONT, INTEG).

phase_registry.description: Relative path to the phase_registry.yaml file.

memory_bank.description: Relative directory path where the pack's memory bank is stored.

rules_root.description: Relative directory path to the cursor/claude rules root.

description.description: Human-readable description of the workflow pack.
